ValidationRule.description: When a Funding Option is Selected, prevent any updates to the details of the option
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED( Opportunity__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( Funding__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED(Selected__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Additional_Information__c)), Selected__c = True, $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Edit_FO_When_Selected__c = False, OR( Funding__r.Lender_Name_Workflow__c = 'National Funding - Platinum WC Funding', Funding__r.Lender_Name_Workflow__c = 'Quick Bridge Funding' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Funding Option details cannot be edited once it's been selected
